title: Word by word
description: A measured word-by-word reveal that lets a short headline land.
useCase: Introduce a short piece of editorial or launch copy. Avoid delaying paragraphs or essential instructions.
reducedMotion: The complete headline is immediately visible, without movement.
limitations: Word splitting is tuned for this English headline. Recheck wrapping and segmentation for other languages.
look: Pale sage-green page with a two-line, tightly tracked dark olive sans-serif headline, left-aligned at centre, and a small replay control bottom right.
motion: On mount each word slides up out of its own overflow mask while fading in, 0.52 s each with a strong ease-out, staggered 75 ms; replay restarts it.
adapt: The stagger is `staggerChildren: 0.075` on the `motion.h2` variants; each word's `motion.span` rises from `y: "100%"` inside an `overflow: "hidden"` wrapper over 0.52 s with ease `[0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]`. Replace `lines` with your copy and keep the heading's `aria-label`.
